title: Pink-haired Fighter Poses
description: Four sequential panels show a female character with pink hair in pigtails performing a martial arts kick sequence against a solid green background. She wears a dark green and black armored outfit with a cape, boots, and gauntlets, progressing from a ready stance to a full side kick with yellow impact effects.
prompt: A four-panel sequence on a solid bright green background showing a tough anime-style female fighter with large pink hair in high pigtails and a small crown. She wears a dark green and black battle outfit with armored shoulder pads, a short cape, fingerless gloves, and heavy boots. The panels show her performing a powerful side kick: starting in a fighting stance with fists raised, lifting her leg, executing a full kick with yellow impact lines, and landing. Cartoonish digital painting style with bold outlines.
